title: fix(types,plugin-chatbot): one authority for ChatMessage, ChatToolInvocation and UndoRedoState (objectui#6349, batch 5)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 5)
Clause-②: yes

Batch 5 of the one-authority burn-down. It covers three ledger rows: `ChatMessage`, `ChatToolInvocation` and `UndoRedoState`. The surface is claim `6078400104` as amended in `6078948754`, which answers the three stops from report `6078910504`. Each row was two meanings rather than one shape that drifted. The card stays open for later batches; this PR carries no closing keyword.

## What changes

| row | route (amendment) | what lands |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `ChatToolInvocation` | A, rename | `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`'s runtime declaration is now `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`, the name the plugin root already published it under. The barrel's aliasing export becomes a plain re-export. `@object-ui/types`' authoring `ChatToolInvocation` is untouched. |
| `ChatMessage` | A, rename | The runtime declaration is now `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`, the name already published for the same type, and it is no longer deprecated. The plugin root **no longer publishes `ChatMessage`**, so the bare name means only the `@object-ui/types` authoring contract. |
| `UndoRedoState` | B, retire | `@object-ui/types`' undo trio (`UndoRedoEntry`, `UndoRedoConfig`, `UndoRedoState`) is retired: it had no reader, no writer and no `@objectstack/spec` counterpart. The designer's `useUndoRedo` hook result is now the one declaration of the name; no designer file changes. |

- **Ledger:** the three rows leave `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` (25 rows down to 22), and each is replaced by an annotation naming its remedy.
- **Readers:** `mapMessages.ts`, `useHitlInChat.ts` and `chatMessageAdapter.ts` change import specifiers only. The 12 test files that used the runtime `ChatMessage` now name `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`.
- **The contract test:** `chat-message-contract.test.ts` now pins the new names. It also pins the retired ones as unresolvable, with `@ts-expect-error` imports whose bindings must stay error-typed, plus a source-level net that the barrel publishes no `ChatMessage`.
- **Docs:** the plugin README and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` code blocks move to `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`. The README section for the type now says the bare name belongs to `@object-ui/types` and carries a one-line migration note.
- **Comments:** `complex.ts` now names the runtime `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`. `ui-action.ts` and the types barrel keep a short note where the trio was.
- **Types only:** transpiled with comments removed, the emitted JS of all 8 changed source files is identical at base and head (one TypeScript transpile per tree state). `types`' tsc-emitted `ui-action.js` gains the tombstone comment and nothing else. The vite-built plugin JS carries none of the changed text (0 hits, control lit). So no first-load bytes move.

## Published surface (built entry declarations, read by the TS checker)

| package | base `5275d1f37` | head | difference |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` | 94 names | 93 | `ChatMessage` removed; `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` and `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation` now resolve to declarations of those names |
| `@object-ui/types` | 711 | 708 | `UndoRedoEntry`, `UndoRedoConfig`, `UndoRedoState` removed |
| `@object-ui/plugin-designer` | 38 | 38 | none (it never published `UndoRedoState` from its root) |

Changesets: `minor` on `@object-ui/types` and on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, each with a breaking-change note naming the removal and its replacement or retirement. ⛔ No `major`. `check-changeset-presence` asks for no designer changeset (no designer file changed).

## Consumer impact (measured)

- `@object-ui/app-shell` (`AiChatPage` imports `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` and `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`): type-check exit 0 against the rebuilt plugin dist.
- In-repo importers of the plugin root `ChatMessage` before this change: the plugin's own contract test only. That census reads TS import clauses over every tracked TS file, with a lit control.
- An external `import { type ChatMessage } from '@object-ui/plugin-chatbot'` now fails loudly with TS2460, which names `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`. That was measured on a probe of the README's former Basic-usage block.
- `UndoRedo*` from `@object-ui/types`: 0 importers anywhere in the repo.

## Verification (head `9e2d463ac`; all heavy runs through `os-verify-lock.sh`)

- **The gate:** `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` gives `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- **Suites:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/plugin-designer/ scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` gives `Test Files 473 passed (473)` and `Tests 11185 passed (11185)`.
- **Type-checks, dist rebuilt first** (`pnpm --filter PKG type-check`, script echoed): `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer` and `@object-ui/app-shell` each exit 0 with 0 `error TS` lines. These four are every package that names these types. The full app-shell suite is declared to CI.
- **Docs:**
  - `pnpm check:doc-snippets`: `784 of 784 block(s) judged, 0 failed`, after the gate's own scoped build.
  - `pnpm check:readme-exports`: OK, 579 of 579 judged self-imports real.
- **Other checks:** `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-presence` are all exit 0. `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new. The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED over 26 paths.
- **eslint** on the 22 touched TS files: 0 errors, warnings only. The one warning on a changed line is the pre-existing `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `getToolState`, whose parameter type was renamed.
- **Ablation:** objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` ran in wrap mode, with predictions written first. Every leg landed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob changed), and every leg restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| stale `ChatMessage` | row put back in the ledger | `Tests 1 failed / 10 passed`, `ChatMessage — no longer collides at:` listing both files |
| stale `ChatToolInvocation` | row put back | same shape, both files |
| stale `UndoRedoState` | row put back | same shape, the designer and types files |
| fresh `ChatMessage` | the barrel re-publishes `ChatbotEnhancedMessage as ChatMessage` | `ChatMessage — a NEW colliding name`: the plugin barrel alias plus the types declaration |
| fresh `ChatToolInvocation` | the barrel re-aliases `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation as ChatToolInvocation` | `a NEW colliding name`: the barrel alias plus the types declaration |
| fresh `UndoRedoState` | `ui-action.ts` re-declares it | `a NEW colliding name`: the designer hook plus `ui-action.ts` |
| control | unmutated tree | `Tests 11 passed (11)` |

## Acceptance notes

- **Comments left stale by the rename, outside the amended surface.** None affects compilation; I did not edit them because the amendment restricts these files (or omits them):
  - `AiChatPage.tsx` in app-shell (the import comment says the barrel's `ChatMessage` IS this type and that new code should spell `ChatMessage`);
  - `useObjectChat.ts` (one comment names `ChatbotEnhanced.ChatMessage`);
  - `chatMessageAdapter.ts` (one comment names `ChatbotEnhanced.ChatMessage`; the amendment limits this file to import specifiers).

  They are a three-file prose follow-up for whoever touches those files next, or a one-line amendment if the seat wants them here.
- **The gate file:** the only line touched outside the three ledger rows is one fixture comment. It cited the contract test by a cross-file line address that this change made false, and it now cites by content.
- **Merge check:** `git merge-tree` against `main` `3c3115e38` is clean. No open PR touched these files at claim time.
